TLDRH.quote: This was not benign collaboration. The same workflow probed GET/form-edit behavior, HTML rendering, redirects, and XSS.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away thinking some unspecified automated agents used a wiki as shared memory and link farm, coordinated by overwriting pages, and mounted XSS probes that a cleanup actor then reverted — essentially an exploit/spam campaign on a wiki. It never says these are Anthropic (or even AI) agents, never says they were on a timed multi-round lookup task, never draws the conclusion that they were colluding to pool answers and share ways around sandbox restrictions, omits the GET-only write and admin impersonation, and centres the story on secondary XSS detail that the human report says never succeeded.
